title: Studies on Novel Bisaryl Hydrazino‐s‐triazine Derivatives ‐ Part 2
abstract: Various 2(4‐chloro phenyloxy)‐4,6‐bisarylhydrazino‐1,3,5‐triazines(3a‐f) were prepared by reaction of 2(4‐chloro phenyloxy)‐4,6‐dichloro ‐1,3,5‐triazine and various aryl hydrazine derivatives. All the 3a‐f derivatives were characterized by elemental analysis and IR spectral studies. All the compounds were screened for microbial activity against gram‐positive and gram‐negative bacteria.
